seasonWindows.label: Snook harvest closed (FWC Atlantic — June–August)
seasonWindows.notes: FWC: Closed June 1 – August 31 for all Atlantic regions. Confirm same-day at https://myfwc.com/fishing/saltwater/recreational/snook/

seasonWindows.label: Snook harvest closed (FWC Atlantic — December–January)
seasonWindows.notes: FWC: Closed December 15 – January 31 for all Atlantic regions. Confirm same-day at https://myfwc.com/fishing/saltwater/recreational/snook/

fwc-atl-snook.provenanceNotes: 2026-08-20 bench: live FWC Snook page. Atlantic Coast closed Jun 1–Aug 31 and Dec 15–Jan 31. Red drum has no dated closed season on that page.

Same-day FWC check required at https://myfwc.com/fishing/saltwater/recreational/snook/

fwc-none.provenanceNotes: 2026-08-20 bench: FWC recreational pages. Documented species have no standing dated harvest closure (bass/crappie year-round under bag/size; red drum no dated closure). Empty seasonWindows = none published, not a gap.

seasonWindows.label: Standard stream season closed (FWP Western District rivers — Dec through 3rd Saturday in May)
seasonWindows.notes: FWP 2026: Western District rivers open 3rd Saturday in May through Nov 30. Recurring closed span Dec 1 through the day before that Saturday (2026 opener May 16). https://fwp.mt.gov/fish/licensing-basics

fwp-west-river.provenanceNotes: 2026-08-20 bench: FWP 2026 district standard regulations. Western District rivers: open 3rd Saturday in May–Nov 30 unless Exceptions apply.

Same-day FWP check required at https://fwp.mt.gov/fish/licensing-basics

fwp-open.provenanceNotes: 2026-08-20 bench: FWP 2026 district standard regulations. Central/Eastern rivers and all-district lakes/reservoirs are open all year unless Exceptions apply. Empty seasonWindows = no standing dated closure.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm district assignment and any Exceptions (hoot-owl, spawning).
Same-day FWP check required at https://fwp.mt.gov/fish/licensing-basics

seasonWindows.label: Southern flounder harvest closed (TPWD Outdoor Annual — Nov–mid December)
seasonWindows.notes: TPWD 2026–27 Outdoor Annual: flounder fishery closed Nov 1 – Dec 14 (bag = 0). https://tpwd.texas.gov/regulations/outdoor-annual/fishing/saltwater-fishing/bag-length-limits/flounder-bag-length-limits

tpwd-flounder.provenanceNotes: 2026-08-20 bench: TPWD Outdoor Annual saltwater. Statewide southern flounder closed Nov 1–Dec 14. Red drum/seatrout have no dated statewide closed season on that page.

tpwd-fresh.provenanceNotes: 2026-08-20 bench: TPWD Outdoor Annual freshwater. No standing dated statewide harvest closure for documented bass/crappie/catfish/striped bass (bag/size manage harvest; open year-round unless a water exception is listed).

seasonWindows.label: Inland walleye / sauger / pike / bass harvest closed (MN DNR — after Feb 28 until fishing opener)
seasonWindows.notes: MN DNR 2026 inland walleye/sauger listed 05/09/26–02/28/27. Recurring closed span Mar 1 through the day before opener. https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/fishing/seasons.html

mn-gamefish.provenanceNotes: 2026-08-20 bench: MN DNR fishing seasons. Inland walleye/sauger 2026 opener May 9 through Feb 28. Panfish remain open year-round on the general inland page. Border waters / Lake Superior can differ.

seasonWindows.label: General trout season closed (IDFG — Dec 1 through Friday before Memorial Day weekend)
seasonWindows.notes: IDFG general trout pattern on many flowing waters: Saturday of Memorial Day weekend through Nov 30 open. 2026 Memorial Day May 25 (Friday before = May 22). Confirm on IDFG Fishing Planner. https://idfg.idaho.gov/rules
